articles.title: Why Are Orcas Sinking Sailboats? Scientists Say It Might Be a Game
articles.summary: A tiny group of fewer than 50 orcas off Spain and Portugal has been ramming sailboats since 2020 — and sank one in July 2026. Experts think the whales may be playing or practicing hunting skills. The oldest orca, Toñi, was recently shot with a pellet gun.

articles.title: Keith Richards Brings His Blues Grit to the Grand Theft Auto VI Soundtrack
articles.summary: Keith Richards recorded a gritty new version of Jimmy Reed's 1961 blues classic "Bright Lights, Big City" for the Grand Theft Auto VI soundtrack, out November 19. The album has 34 songs. Richards has been on a solo streak lately.

articles.title: Earth: The Only Planet We Know With Life (And Pizza)
articles.summary: Earth is the only planet known to harbor life, from microscopic amoebas to blue whales. It's the third rock from the sun, with a perfect temperature for liquid water. Scientists know more about the moon's surface than our own ocean floors.
